key_insight: A fine-tuned local safety classifier approached cloud-judge accuracy while screening in 39.0 ms, supporting rapid triage with cloud escalation for ambiguous cases.
clinical_relevance: Local screening could reduce safety-check delays in clinical AI workflows while checking PHI exposure, clinical scope, reading level, and brand-policy compliance.
method: Screen queries with an on-host Tier-1 classifier; escalate ambiguous cases to a Tier-2 cloud LLM judge.
Evaluate four length-matched contrastive twin benchmarks designed to limit length and unigram shortcuts.
Fine-tune a 335M-parameter BGE-Large encoder for multi-policy classification.
evidence_signal: On the multi-policy benchmark, the fine-tuned classifier achieved 98.90% out-of-fold accuracy versus 99.20% for a zero-shot cloud judge (exact McNemar p = 0.648), with over 14× faster evaluation on the benchmark host.
watch_item: Reading-level violation recall remained lower at 93.3%–95.3%; benchmark results do not establish real-world clinical safety or validate escalation thresholds.
paper_title: Multi-Tier Edge Triage: Optimizing Latency for Safe Clinical Agents
